title: campanula rotundifolia var. stenophylla
intro: Campanula rotundifolia var. stenophylla, commonly known as Scottish bluebell, is a plant species within the bellflower family that is native to Scotland and other parts of Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia var. stenophylla include its ability to act as a nervine, helping to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, as well as its antispasmodic properties, which can help to relieve muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
